column3: 12/01/2018 - Effort being continued by community. Huge amount of credit to Enlir for the years of effort he put into it.
11/22/2018 Project updates from Enlir discontinued due to retirement. Thanks to everyone for your support and appreciation!
See an error? Reach out to us on Discord (https://discord.gg/Fv7E7Ve, tag @Community Developer) or Reddit on /r/FFRecordKeeper (/u/mendicant)
Thanks to /u/ffrkthrowawaykeeper for summarizing the record board stat information!

For most tabs, I highly suggest using filters for an easier comparison of the data. In google docs, you should be able to enable them with "Data" -> "Filter Views" -> "Create a temp filter view". This will allow you to sort colums by content. As a general rule, data in light-colored cells is considered JP content and is yet unreleased in Global.
